CustomField.description: This field is used to display quantity on Invoice template
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL( blng__Product__r.SBQQ__PricingMethod__c , 'Block' ) , 1 , IF( OR( ( blng__Product__r.ProductCode = "PPUA" ) , ( blng__Product__r.ProductCode = "PPUW2" ) , ( blng__Product__r.ProductCode = "PUA" ) , ( blng__Product__r.ProductCode = "PUW2" ) ) , ABS( blng__Quantity__c ) , blng__Quantity__c ) )
CustomField.label: Qty for Template
